transaction_cost.basis: absolute traded notional / pre-trade portfolio equity
transaction_cost.netting: within each pair leg; no netting across different pairs
transaction_cost.rebalance: daily targets versus price-drifted holdings after previous costs
transaction_cost.monthly_boundary: carry retained pairs; close removed pairs and open new pairs
transaction_cost.execution_prices: existing close-to-close marked prices; missing quotes forward-filled

ranking: descending parent adf_score; ties by asset_x then asset_y
capital_fraction: min(1, sqrt(risk_budget / unscaled_training_variance)); 1 at zero variance
